name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme
briefDescription: A non-contributory pension scheme to provide social security to widows of poor family (BPL)  of the society.
descriptionMd: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS) is implemented by Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India. It is a non-contributory pension scheme to provide social security to widows of poor family (BPL)  of the society.
benefitsMd: A pension of ₹ 300/- per month is provided to Widows between 40 years and 79 years. For persons who are 80 years and above, the pension is ₹ 500/- per month.
eligibilityMd: The eligibility criteria under Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme (IGNWPS) is: - The applicant must be a widow in the age group of 40-79 years. - The applicant should belong to a household living below the poverty line according to the criteria prescribed by the Govt. of India
exclusionsMd:
Pension will be discontinued
- In case of remarriage of widow - Once the widow moves above poverty line
applicationMd: - One can download UMANG App or visit website [https://web.umang.gov.in/web_new/home](https://web.umang.gov.in/web_new/home) - The citizen can login using mobile number and OTP. - Once logged In, citizen can search for NSAP. - Click on “Apply Online” - Fill the basic details, choose the mode of payment of pension, upload photo and click on “Submit”.
